name: OOP & C++
blurb: Short videos only: every pick is 20 minutes or less and covers one or two ideas, ordered as a sequence. CopperSpice, C++ Weekly and The Cherno supply most of them.
method:
• Length: hard cap of 20 minutes per video; depth comes from a sequence.
  • Order: picks in a subtopic are in watching order; the first is the starting point.
  • Sources: CopperSpice (Barbara Geller and Ansel Sermersheim) for language-lawyer depth, Jason Turner's C++ Weekly for single features and pitfalls, The Cherno for mechanics, Mike Shah, mCoding and Nick (CoffeeBeforeArch) for specific topics.

subtopics.name: Short-video courses
